Radiology Report
Date: 09/14/2026
Patient: Victor Osinski, 65-year-old female

Examination: CT Lumbar Spine

Findings:
CT lumbar spine 09/14/2026: L4-L5 disc herniation with moderate left foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.

Impression:
There is a herniated disc at the L4-L5 level causing moderate narrowing of the left neural foramen and contact with the exiting nerve root. No other significant abnormalities are noted.

Recommendations:
Clinical correlation is advised to assess for symptoms related to nerve root compression. Further evaluation or management should be guided by the referring physician.
